rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for invented characters, stories, films, and other fictional works.

example.english: This film tells the story of a fictional character.
example.traditional: 呢套電影講一個虛構人物嘅故事。

rows.note: Use this when a work is partly based on reality but contains invented elements.

example.english: This film, which is partly based on real events but contains fictional elements, is quite enjoyable.
example.traditional: 呢套根據真人真事改編、帶有虛構成分嘅電影幾好睇。
